info.title: tailtrails-api
info.description: General API for the TailTrails frontend.

post.description:
Login using a Firebase ID token. Ensures local user exists and returns token/user data.

Parameters:
    request (Request): The incoming HTTP request containing the Firebase access token in JSON body.
    db (AsyncSession): The database session dependency.
Returns:
    TokenSchema: The access token and user data.
Raises:
    HTTPException: If token verification or user retrieval/creation fails.

Request an OTP code to be sent to the user's email.

This endpoint generates a 6-digit OTP code and sends it to the user's email address.
The code expires after 5 minutes.

Verify the OTP code and authenticate the user.

This endpoint verifies the 6-digit OTP code sent to the user's email
and returns a JWT token for authentication.

Request user registration with OTP verification.

This endpoint initiates the passwordless user registration process.
A 6-digit OTP code is sent to the provided email address.

Verify user registration and complete account creation.

This endpoint verifies the OTP code for user registration and activates the account.
Returns a JWT token for immediate authentication.
